verdicts.reason: Both use the same scattered layout. The subhead 'Every mixed case.' sits at the top middle, cut off from its '20% off' headline, so the reading order is jumbled. The headline has switched from the original sans to a serif, the circle is cropped at the bottom, and the product and legal line float with no grid. A is slightly better because its CTA and legal line share a right edge with an even margin. B pulls both inward and leaves dead space on the right, and its 'Shop Sale' letters look tightly squeezed.
